summary: Iteration 2 — RightPolicy expansion (claim support, service pages, admin dashboard, JWT auth, WhatsApp float). Backend: 16/16 pytest cases passing across admin auth (login success/wrong-pw/me with/without/invalid token), claim-support create + 422 invalid email, admin lists requiring auth (inquiries/uploads/claims), filter+search, stats shape, PATCH inquiries (status/notes + 400 invalid status + 404 unknown id), PATCH+download policy uploads (Content-Disposition with original filename), PATCH claim-requests. Frontend: navbar shows Services dropdown + Claim Support nav + 'Get Claim Support' + 'Book a Free Consultation' CTAs, WhatsApp float visible bottom-right, all 6 service detail pages render (health/motor/life/business/travel/personal-accident), /claim-support page renders hero ('You don’t have to face a claim alone.') + CTAs + FAQ, ClaimSupportDialog submits POST /api/claim-support 201 with success toast, RequireAdmin redirects /admin → /admin/login when no token, invalid creds shows error, valid creds stores rp_admin_token in localStorage and redirects to /admin, dashboard shows 3 stat cards (inquiries/uploads/claims) with counts + 3 tabs + search + status filter + per-row status select + notes editor save + contact icons (mail/phone/whatsapp) + download button on uploads tab, logout clears token and redirects. Backend logs show '[email-skipped]' for Resend when RESEND_API_KEY empty (by design).

issues: Clean layout — stat cards, tabs, table with contact icons; status dropdown uses native browser select (acceptable for internal admin)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: JWT_SECRET correctly read from .env; tokens decoded with HS256; valid statuses guarded; admin endpoints all behind get_current_admin dependency. Good.
server.py startup: bcrypt seed/refresh is idempotent — creates if missing, refreshes hash only when env password no longer matches. Format is $2b$ (bcrypt default). Good.
server.py: /api/admin/policy-uploads/{id}/download uses FileResponse with original filename; correctly streams binary; 410 if file missing.
server.py: send_email_async correctly logs '[email-skipped]' when RESEND_API_KEY empty without raising. No-op fallback works as designed.

AdminDashboardPage.jsx (~763 lines) is approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting per-tab components (InquiriesTab/UploadsTab/ClaimsTab) into separate files for maintainability — non-blocking.
Frontend stat-card testids use keys 'inquiries'/'uploads'/'claims' (not the API field names policy_uploads/claim_requests). Documented for next testing agent.
CORS allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' is technically invalid per spec; works due to FastAPI handling but consider explicit origins for production. Non-blocking for preview env.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 home + 9/9 admin; 1 selector-typo in test, not a product bug)
